title: coleus batesii
intro: Coleus batesii, commonly known as Coleus aromaticus, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to tropical regions of India. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Coleus batesii include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
